posts.title: Storytelling as Data: From a Personal Research Statement to an Interactive Visual Network
posts.description: I’ve been thinking a lot about how stories can be translated into data visualizations, and what we gain or lose in that process. posts.title: Practicing Attention & Slowing Down: A Visual Inquiry into Storytelling, Photographic Memory, and Meaning Making through Collage
posts.description: This essay follows a yoga retreat in Costa Rica through journal entries organized around five lessons and a photographic archive of landscapes, movement, rituals, materials, and moments of attention. posts.title: From practice to publication: Reflections on relational labor, shared authorship, play, and long-term assessment published in CoDesign Journal
posts.description: This article reflects on what community-based design requires beyond conventional graphic design skills, using the City of We case study and my recent CoDesign publication to examine relational labor, shared authorship, play, ethical boundaries, and long-term assessment.
